title: Harmonic immersions of the Sierpinski gasket into the hyperbolic plane
summary: Many fractals $G$ admit a harmonic immersion into $\R^n$, i.e. an immersion which minimises a natural energy under fixed boundary conditions; we look for harmonic immersions of the Sierpinski gasket into the hyperbolic plane. We show that, given any three points $\tilde A$, $\tilde B$, $\tilde C$ in the hyperbolic plane there is a harmonic map bringing the three points $A$, $B$, $C$ of the boundary of the gasket to $\tilde A$, $\tilde B$, $\tilde C$ respectively.
